# 🚀 semrel — Semantic Release Automation Without Node.js

**semrel** automates your entire **Semantic Versioning (SemVer)** and release lifecycle using [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) — shipped as a **single ~12 MB static Go binary** with **zero Node.js dependencies**, **46 official plugins**, **monorepo workspaces**, **air-gap lockfiles (`.semrel.lock`)**, and **Sigstore Cosign v3 + SBOM + SLSA Level 1** supply-chain security.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| **Auto SemVer from Commits** | **✅ Conventional Commits & Regex** | ✅ Conventional Commits | ❌ Manual Git tags (OSS) | ✅ Release PRs |
| **Scope-Based Bump Rules** | **✅ Native** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |

| **Plugin Ecosystem** | **46 official plugins (any language)** | JavaScript-only npm packages | Built-in Go steps | Hardcoded |

## 🧩 46 Official Plugins Across 8 Pipeline Categories

- **Conditions (6):** [`condition-github-actions`](https://github.com/SemRels/condition-github-actions) (GitHub & GHES) · [`condition-gitlab-ci`](https://github.com/SemRels/condition-gitlab-ci) · [`condition-gitea-actions`](https://github.com/SemRels/condition-gitea-actions) · [`condition-bitbucket-pipelines`](https://github.com/SemRels/condition-bitbucket-pipelines) · [`condition-circleci`](https://github.com/SemRels/condition-circleci) · [`condition-generic`](https://github.com/SemRels/condition-generic)

## 🚀 Quick Start in 60 Seconds

```bash
# Install semrel (or use ghcr.io/semrels/semrel:latest-alpine)
go install github.com/SemRels/semrel/cmd/semrel@latest

# Initialize .semrel.yaml with IDE JSON Schema support
semrel config init

# Install & pin official plugins in .semrel.lock
semrel plugin install @semrel/condition-github-actions
semrel plugin install @semrel/generator-changelog-md
semrel plugin install @semrel/provider-github

# Validate setup and preview release
semrel doctor
semrel release --dry-run
```
